summary: Add signed native fleet roll authority and own-daemon adoption collection for fleet/roll-completion: every immutable target host verifies within 24h, with a roll-level 10% allowance over 30 days.

replay.detail: Signed resource.observed graph claims are authority. Startup revalidates retained references and currently usable delegated key chains; historical signature authentication cannot preserve cached good after revocation. The roll runtime initializes existing canonical database/source lifecycle state without attaching optional views, enabling claim-capture hooks or overriding an existing epoch, retention choice or unavailable state. Indexed commit ingestion waits for declaration, resolution, source enrollment, frontier predecessor and every delta receipt, including host observations. Quiet native source closure uses signed bounded deltas, never repeated all-history manifests. Unsigned legacy roll-receipts.sqlite3 is diagnostic only.

schema.detail: No new registered claim or resource kinds. Existing open custom.fractal.fleet-roll-receipt observations carry roll-declared, host-target-resolved, host-observed, intent-observed, source-enabled and source-frontier version-1 facts under existing signatures. Intent-onset proofs bind authenticated original native creation, pinned resource input, source enrollment and immutable declaration IDs; generic publication is forbidden. Frontier deltas include these dependencies, contain at most 512 receipt IDs, and version a stable producer/host/incarnation subject with database/source lifetime binding. GET /v1/slo/roll-intent and its CLI expose canonical creation acceptance and pinned revision. Effective onset only refines earlier as native intent proof arrives; declaration and target identity never change. The existing signed-reference ledger retains replay authority.

rules.detail: Only an actual bound agent with declared roll-authority may publish declarations, resolutions and source enrollment. Resolutions bind the admitted declaration and same signer. Generic host-observed and source-frontier publication is forbidden, including bound agents; own-daemon native measurement signs as host/HOST. Cohort, resolution and clock are immutable. Host targets cover dotfiles, system, Home Manager and daemon only. Identity and Verification reject unknown fields; removed factory_revision is rejected even when null, never ignored or treated as unknown adoption. Holds never pause the clock. Missing supported evidence never becomes good or bad.

compatibility.detail: SLO reads gain one native row with source-and-mirror completeness. Every configured producer and current host incarnation must close its own native intent stream; missing, stale or incomplete history is no-data, never healthy or exhausted. Ratios and burn evaluate at the common proven cut with an explicit unknown tail and 24h lookback. Initial enrollment requires real accumulated history. Existing graph signatures and resource bindings are reused; unsigned JSON imports are removed.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond installing/restarting the daemon. Signed ledger replay completes before serving; replicated missing dependencies remain unknown while admission catches up.

manual.detail: Declare roll-authority on the actual deployment agent. Publish source-enabled stable journal facts from the real bound agent before declaration effects, omitting the generic idempotency key for enrollment so key rotation cannot replay a revoked proof forever. Equivalent signed candidates retain the earliest still-valid coverage epoch; revoked history is not promoted. Declarations and resolutions keep immutable idempotency. Native enrollment clamps caller clocks to durable acceptance. Every member performs census/quiet closure automatically; generic source-frontier and host-observed publication is forbidden. Observe through the own daemon socket and use roll-intent for canonical onset/revision.

recovery.detail: Preserve graph claims and signatures plus signed receipt reference ledger/WAL in backups. Exact signed retries are idempotent, including the current frontier after its predecessor is pruned from the hot reducer, and conflicts are refused. Superseded native writer positions are terminal watcher candidates; genuinely unadmitted predecessors and receipt deltas still wait. Graph replay re-establishes source authority; unauthenticated JSON cannot predeclare a legitimate roll ID. Missing graph provenance or unavailable probes remain unknown.
